peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (CCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Price position
positions.bandLabel: Higher relative price than most peers
positions.statement: Price position — Higher relative price than most peers: 12.1% above its local comparables; 113 of 144 similar developments with a figure have a lower relative price (a position, not a measure of value).

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Above peers (88.3): 5.2 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 356 of 405 similar developments with a figure (the same as 3). Context, not scored: resales in 62.5% of months (24 months).

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (CCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments
lines.statement: 3-bedroom: median $5,250,000 ($2,695 psf, 1,948–2,142 sq ft; 7 resales, Sep 2024–Aug 2026); 8 comparable developments within 3 km: median $2,398 psf (range $2,073–3,450); 12.4% above; illustrative entry-price difference about $579,000 more. 4-bedroom: median $7,700,000 ($2,937 psf, 2,454–2,927 sq ft; 7 resales, Jun 2025–May 2026); 8 comparable developments within 3 km: median $2,630 psf (range $2,104–4,290); 11.7% above; illustrative entry-price difference about $805,000 more. The entry-price difference is illustrative: the median price adjusted to the comparable median psf, for a similar-size unit. A premium or a discount is not in itself an advantage or a disadvantage.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: No first resale wave in the observation period: sustained activity is the observed activity.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Newton MRT about 350 m, Novena MRT about 1,020 m; closer than 360 of 551 similar developments (the same as 9). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 2 within 1 km and 6 within 2 km; nearest Anglo-Chinese School (Primary) about 360 m; more than 310 of 551 similar developments (the same as 182). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 3 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 280 m), more than 73 of 551 similar developments (the same as 47); nearest hawker centre Newton Food Centre about 580 m; nearest park Malcolm Park about 1,160 m. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 8 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (32 Gilstead, 3 new sales, about 480 m; Sanctuary@Newton, 16 new sales, about 680 m; 21 Anderson, 6 new sales, about 870 m; The Giverny Residences, 2 new sales, about 980 m; Park Nova, 4 new sales, about 1,680 m; Orchard Sophia, 13 new sales, about 1,800 m; Grange 1866, 6 new sales, about 1,840 m; Piccadilly Grand, 1 new sales, about 1,930 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 426 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 101 new sales and 974 resales (1,075 purchases); new sales were 9.4% of these purchases. Subsales (53) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Unsold inventory

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

lines.label: Known pipeline

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: Within 2 km: Bukit Timah Road GLS site (government land sale site, awarded), about 290 m; Peck Hay Road GLS site (government land sale site, awarded), about 500 m; The Serra Residences (launch, launched, about 4 homes), about 1,630 m; upcoming Sophia Meadow development, about 1,760 m; Dorset Road GLS site (government land sale site, awarded), about 1,960 m. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Not a quiet area. 974 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 254 of 551 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 974 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 1,080 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−9.8%). Planning-area private resales +16%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
